pending.scenario: Technical inquiry about production reliability / benchmarks
pending.suggested_reply: Good callout. In practice, the primary constraint isn't the framework wrapper, but token latency and context drift over multi-step runs. For production, sandboxing tool execution and enforcing strict schema validation upfront prevents 80% of edge case failures.

The biggest delta is privacy and infrastructure lock-in. Self-hosting this on European bare-metal (like Hetzner or local Ollama) costs $0 in SaaS license overhead and guarantees your internal code doesn't leave your network perimeter.
